title: DataCredibility
description: ISO 25012-sourced data quality archetype — Credibility inherent data quality characteristic. The degree to which data has attributes that are regarded as true and believable by users in a specific context of use. Credibility includes the concept of authenticity (the truthfulness of origins, attributions, commitments). Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms governing data entities. Source: ISO/IEC 25012 (Inherent Data Quality — Credibility).

credibilityLevel.description: Trustworthiness classification of data origin. UNVERIFIED = unknown provenance. USER_REPORTED = user-supplied without validation. SYSTEM_GENERATED = produced by automated systems. AUTHORITATIVE = from a recognized authoritative source.

provenanceTracked.description: Whether data provenance (origin, transformations, chain of custody) is tracked.

certificationRequired.description: Whether data must be certified or attested by an authoritative party.
